args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions. Mitigation performed: rolled back checkout-api to the most recent release that was healthy in production, v2.3.0, in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback completed successfully ("rolled_out" status). Follow-up: investigate the health check failures introduced in v2.3.1 to identify root cause before any re-deploy attempt.
args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after latest deploy; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary of actions:

1. **Diagnosed**: Deployment history showed v2.3.1 (the latest produção release) was unhealthy, while v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (`list_deployments`).
2. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) — the rollback completed with "rolled_out" status.
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure and the mitigation, and the on-call engineer was paged.

Follow-up recommendation: investigate what broke health checks in v2.3.1 before considering a re-deploy.
